q: Cells are organized into tissues, organs, and organ systems.
e: This statement is true as it describes the hierarchical organization of biological systems.

q: In multicellular organisms, all cells perform the same functions independently.
e: The correct fact is that in multicellular organisms, cells often have specialized functions and work together.

q: A tissue is a group of cells with similar structures working together to perform a particular function.
e: This statement is true as it defines what a tissue is in biological terms.

q: Organs are composed of a single type of tissue only.
e: The correct fact is that organs are composed of multiple types of tissues working together.

q: The root system in plants is composed of main roots and branches.
e: This statement is true as the root system serves to absorb water and minerals from the soil.

q: Animal tissues consist of five basic groups.
e: The correct fact is that animal tissues consist of four basic groups: epithelial, connective, muscle, and nervous.

q: The seven main systems in the human body include the digestive system, gas exchange system, and circulatory system.
e: This statement is true as these are indeed part of the major systems in the human body.

q: The heart is an example of an organ that contains only muscle tissue.
e: The correct fact is that the heart contains cardiac muscle, connective tissue, and epithelial tissue.
